clues: This city lies in the northeast of Hainan Island. It is in the south of China.
Big Pacific storms hit this coast again and again. Their waves flood the land more often here than anywhere else nearby.
In 2016, China opened its newest spaceport in this city. Rockets now fly from this coast into space.
A chicken dish from this city started a famous rice dish. People eat that rice dish all over Southeast Asia.
Many families who left China long ago still call this city their old home. Their roots reach back to its streets.
